english: if God is for us, who can be against us?

terms.latin: Sī Deus prō nōbīs, quis contrā nōs?
terms.comment: We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
